best_idea: One engine tick that gives every per-object AI check a fixed 16-bucket stagger keyed by a stable id, so a crowd budget is a count of evaluations per tick.
decision_why: Take the stagger and idle/trigger gates for zone NPCs, but reject the wall-clock tick: the server needs a fixed-step accumulator, the tick rate must not come from a client frame cap, and engaged attackers (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3) must never wait for a bucket.
acceptance: A server test feeds a 100 ms stall into the tick clock and asserts no lost or doubled duel steps, and with 200 idle neutral NPCs only about N/16 evaluate on any tick while the 3 engaged attackers evaluate on every tick.
